Shape === mcp-specs/_template.json (X2.1). Web scraping + search + crawl + extract; read-only over the public web. CC0-1.0.
title: Firecrawl Web Scraping & Search
description: Scrape, search, map, crawl, and extract structured data from the live web via the official Firecrawl MCP server.

env_vars.name: FIRECRAWL_API_KEY
env_vars.description: Firecrawl API key (`fc-…`) for the cloud API (the default). Optional only when pointing at a self-hosted instance via FIRECRAWL_API_URL. Pass via env, never inline in args (doctrine #6).

env_vars.name: FIRECRAWL_API_URL
env_vars.description: Custom API endpoint for a self-hosted Firecrawl instance (e.g. https://firecrawl.your-domain.com). Defaults to the Firecrawl cloud API.

env_vars.name: FIRECRAWL_OAUTH_TOKEN
env_vars.description: Static Firecrawl OAuth access token (`fco_…`) — an alternative to FIRECRAWL_API_KEY for stdio. Use access tokens only, never refresh tokens (`fcr_…`).

auth.recipe: create a Firecrawl account and set FIRECRAWL_API_KEY to your `fc-…` key (firecrawl.dev/app/api-keys); or point FIRECRAWL_API_URL at a self-hosted instance.

sample_tools.name: firecrawl_scrape
sample_tools.summary: Scrape a single URL into clean structured data or markdown.

sample_tools.name: firecrawl_search
sample_tools.summary: Search the web and optionally scrape result content.

sample_tools.name: firecrawl_map
sample_tools.summary: Discover all indexed URLs on a website.

sample_tools.name: firecrawl_crawl
sample_tools.summary: Start an async crawl of a site and extract content from its pages.

sample_tools.name: firecrawl_check_crawl_status
sample_tools.summary: Check the status of a crawl job.

sample_tools.name: firecrawl_extract
sample_tools.summary: Extract structured data from web pages using an LLM and a schema.

sample_tools.name: firecrawl_batch_scrape
sample_tools.summary: Scrape multiple known URLs efficiently in one batch.

known_limitations: Requires a Firecrawl API key (FIRECRAWL_API_KEY) for the default cloud API; a self-hosted instance via FIRECRAWL_API_URL can run without one.
Scrape, search, crawl, and extract consume Firecrawl credits — deep crawls and the autonomous agent draw down quota faster; credit-warning thresholds are configurable.
Crawl and agent jobs are asynchronous — they return a job ID and you poll firecrawl_check_crawl_status / firecrawl_agent_status for results, which can take minutes.
Destructive-action audit (X2.18): no destructive tools — Firecrawl scrapes/searches/extracts public web content and does not mutate your resources.

client_install.claude_desktop: Add to claude_desktop_config.json mcpServers as `firecrawl`: { command: npx, args: [-y, firecrawl-mcp], env: { FIRECRAWL_API_KEY: "fc-..." } }.
client_install.cursor: Settings → MCP → Add: name `firecrawl`, command `npx -y firecrawl-mcp`; set FIRECRAWL_API_KEY in the env.
client_install.vscode: Add to .vscode/mcp.json servers as `firecrawl` (VS Code Insider, MCP preview); supply FIRECRAWL_API_KEY via inputs.
